items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Seminole was in Sammy Lewis' band with the Bamboo Follies.

ctx.x: /Seminole was in Sammy Lewis' band with the Bamboo Follies. Yes, Seminole, this man was left-handed and it sounded like two pianos, that he was playing and the same thing with the banjo and guitar.
Sonny Greer heard him play xylophone.
